envelope.description: End the daemon without the hanging exit once its store has failed

body.title: End the daemon without the hanging exit once its store has failed
body.summary: When the record is locks-lost, the shutdown does not wait for the queue: from the shutdown function it stops the queue, the watcher and the server, skips the store's close, removes the pid file and socket, writes its last log line synchronously and sends itself SIGKILL. reportFatal ends the same way in that state. With the record ok both are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: A child running the daemon's shutdown with its store brought to locks-lost exits within 5 seconds of the stop request; the pid file and socket are gone; a second start in the same home succeeds
The last line of that child's log, written before the self-kill, says that the store's close was skipped and why
A child with its store at locks-lost that raises an unhandled rejection exits within 5 seconds with its pid file and socket gone
A healthy daemon's shutdown still drains the queue, closes its connections in the same order and exits through the same path

tests.name: store failure to stop: exit within 5 seconds, pid file and socket gone, second start succeeds, last log line names the skipped close
status after failure: storeFailure names another process and does not contain 'semume'
fatal after failure: an unhandled rejection with the store failed ends the process within 5 seconds
healthy shutdown is unchanged: queue drained, connections closed in order, normal exit
